The [[Prismatic Chest]] is the end chest of the [[Ooze Pit]] dungeon and will spawn when the three [[Prismatic Ooze|Prismatic Oozes]] and the two [[Hulking Volatile Ooze|Hulking Volatile Oozes]] that each spawns are slain. Each player in the party may open the chest and will receive one [[Prismatic Gelatinous Material]], as well as one item from the drop list in normal mode (two in hard mode). After the chest has been opened by every player, a countdown timer will begin and the party will be transported outside the dungeon after three minutes.
